HOW TO READ THESE TABLES

MODEL columns are this model's numbers. Each sportsbook column shows that book's newest pregame price for the exact team and line in the row, with the time it was captured and its age when the page was built. Prices more than 6 hours old, or captured for a game that has since tipped off, are labelled as saved historical prices; your browser re-checks this when you open the page. “Market not posted in latest provider response” means no price was on file. BOOK NO-VIG % is the average of each book's two-sided price with the margin removed. Model lean uses current (non-stale) quotes only.

THE BOARD / NBA

Season record

SAVED PREGAME FORECASTS

Grading method & historical line sources

One forecast per game or player, saved strictly before tip-off. First means the first saved model forecast, not the sportsbook opening. Spread and total leans require at least 0.5 points of difference; smaller differences are passes. Team filters show games involving that team and player projections for that team.

Historical backfills use archive snapshots and book updates at or before the selected forecast, strictly before tip-off, with a six-hour maximum snapshot age. Fixed book priority: DraftKings, BetMGM, Caesars. Original saved lines take priority. Backfills were retrieved after the games; they are retrospective comparisons. Expand a game in Game Results for sources and timestamps.

Minutes and stat errors include recorded appearances only. Missing appearances and DNPs are excluded, not treated as zero. Actual team minutes include every recorded player appearance; projected totals include players with a saved forecast who played. Coverage shows how many recorded appearances had a forecast. Point-bucket hit rates are descriptive; small samples do not establish a profitable edge. Winner accuracy is straight-up accuracy. No betting ROI is inferred.

HOW THE MODEL DID

Latest saved prediction strictly before tip-off for each game. Only final games count. Winner accuracy measures the model favourite; margin and total misses are prediction errors, not betting returns.

DateGameModel favouriteFinal score (away–home)WinnerModel resultMargin missTotal miss

THE ENGINE

Model version nba-weekly-20261026T145124Z-team_only · production variant team-only · data through 2026-10-28 · model run WED OCT 28, 8:58 PM ET.
Each game gets an expected score for both teams from possession-based team ratings (offense and defense per 100 possessions, pace, home court, rest). The spread, total and win probability on this page are all read from that one projection, so they agree with each other. Win % uses the projected margin and its fitted uncertainty; fair ML is that win % as American odds with no margin. The numbers come from team ratings only: the roster estimate below is research and context, not applied to any number on this page. No player props are shown on this page.

HOW IT WAS TESTED

Every game predicted before its own result, season by season: fitted on 2016-17..2021-22, checked on 2022-23..2024-25, final test on 2025-26. Against final scores only - none - no trustworthy historical NBA odds on disk. No edge is claimed.

WHAT IT CANNOT SEE

Injury or rest news at tip-off is not in the numbers (the roster research above is not applied). No player props. Early-season numbers lean on last season's ratings, so they are least reliable in the first weeks. The model has not been tested against sportsbook prices; a gap between the model and a book is a lean in points, not a betting advantage.
Team logos: ESPN (a.espncdn.com), linked, not re-hosted; logos are the property of the NBA and its teams. Data: NBA public stats and schedule feeds (unofficial). Sportsbook prices: cached snapshots at the times shown. Freshness is taken from the source timestamps (model as_of, quote capture times), not the build time; page built WED OCT 28, 9:31 PM ET · 2940 quote(s) captured after tip-off were ignored (in-play prices are not pregame lines).
